reviews.author: Priya S.
reviews.title: Worth every penny
reviews.body: The depth is perfect for sinking in with a book. The feather-wrapped cushions still look great after three months, and delivery was seamless.

reviews.author: Daniel M.
reviews.title: Looks far more expensive than it is
reviews.body:
Got the Velvet in Navy and it's stunning in our living room.

The frame feels very solid and the white-glove team assembled everything in minutes.

reviews.author: Aisha K.
reviews.title: Comfortable, a little deep for me
reviews.body: Gorgeous sofa and very comfortable. At 5'2" my feet don't quite touch the floor when I sit all the way back, so I use a pillow. Otherwise no complaints.

reviews.author: Tom R.
reviews.body: Performance linen has handled two kids and a dog without a mark.

reviews.author: Marguerite Delacroix-Whitmore
reviews.title: Good sofa, long wait
reviews.body: The sofa itself is lovely and well made, but delivery took closer to eight weeks than the quoted four to six. Communication from the team was good, though.

reviews.author: Chris L.
reviews.title: Great, but feathers need fluffing
reviews.body: Cushions are plush but need daily fluffing to keep their shape. That's expected with feather fill, so I'm not marking it down much.

reviews.author: Sofia B.
reviews.title: Our favorite piece of furniture
reviews.body: Everyone who visits asks where we got it. Color Slate looks great in natural light.

reviews.author: Greg H.
reviews.title: Color differed from photos
reviews.body: The Oatmeal was noticeably warmer than it looked online. Quality is fine, but I wish the photos were more accurate. Customer service offered a swatch exchange.

reviews.author: Nina P.
reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.body: Exactly what I was looking for.
